newsitem.title: USA: Videonics sees Q2 loss $0.19 to $0.21/shr.
newsitem.headline: Videonics sees Q2 loss $0.19 to $0.21/shr.

text.p: Videonics Inc, a maker of digital video production equipment, Thursday said it expects a second quarter loss between $0.19 and $0.21 a share based on revenues of about $5.5 million.
In a statement, the company also said it has begun shipping the PowerScript Studio line of character generators that it had expected to ship in the second quater.
"We originally anticipated shipments in the second quarter," said Jim McNeill, Chief Financial Officer.
Analysts had expected a loss of $0.11 a share in the second quarter, according to First Call.
In the year ago quarter, Videonics posted a profit of $0.04 a share on revenue of about $7.0 million.
The new line of PowerScript products enhances performance for high-end users of the video equipment.
The company said it has shipped more than 1000 units of the original PowerScript PS-1000 CG.

"We believe the introduction of the Studio package will expand our presence and importance in the broadcast and high-end studios CG market," said Jim Francis, executive vice president of sales and marketing.
